knobs.note: BH-8079: the lane alerts (warn, id project-21-check-failing) when more than this percent of the counted builds in the window say project-21 state=failed, and resolves the alert at or under it. Read by bin/project-21-daily.sh as ${project-21_DAILY_FAIL_PCT:-50}.

BH-8079: the window of builds the lane counts: a build dir whose last pipeline.log project-21 line is stamped within this many hours. Read by bin/project-21-daily.sh as ${project-21_DAILY_WINDOW_H:-24}.
Read by bin/project-21-daily.sh as ${project-21_DAILY_NOW:-<date +%s>}: the clock the window is counted from. Test seam; NOT settable from the control plane.
